description: 4DA guard: before an edit or an install command writes a dependency version, it needs a dependency_check verdict of proceed or review from the last 24 hours. FOURDA_GUARD=advise advises after the edit instead; FOURDA_GUARD=off turns the hook off. Beside a 4da server older than 6.5.0, which records no verdict, it denies nothing and advises after the edit.
